body: Recommend a hand-rolled reqwest Bot API module for crates/hub instead of teloxide: cctg needs ~12 methods, routes by its own registry rather than dptree, and needs its own outbound queue for the 20 msg/min per-group ceiling anyway, which makes teloxide's Throttle adaptor redundant; teloxide's last release is 0.17.0 (2025-07-11, TBA 9.1) while the Bot API is at 10.3. Named alternative kept as fallback: frankenstein 0.52.0 (2026-08-28, TBA 10.3) for typed models if api.rs passes ~600 lines.

Open questions 1 and 3 (nested claude -p env overwrite; development-channel flag with --resume) are turned into executable spike tasks TASK-003 and TASK-004 rather than answered from docs: the hooks reference does not list CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID among hook environment variables at all, and the channels docs never mention resume. Alternative rejected: asserting the CLAUDE.md hypothesis as verified and building nesting detection on it.

Telegram client: chose bare reqwest with narrow serde structs over the named alternative teloxide 0.17.0. teloxide's last release (2025-07-11) covers Bot API 9.1 and master caps at 9.2 while the live Bot API is 10.3; MVP needs 11 long-stable methods and its own outbound scheduler anyway, and the project invariant forbids modelling the whole Bot API. frankenstein 0.52 kept as the named fallback.

Rejected PLAN_V2's subagent-source rationale: it cited the official Hooks reference for SubagentStop.agent_transcript_path, for asynchronous transcript lag, and for a PreToolUse/PostToolUse recipe capturing SubagentHandback.tool_input.message. Verification against code.claude.com found none of those three in the docs; only last_assistant_message and the existence of the SubagentHandback tool (2.1.271+) hold. The fallback ORDER survives because it is correct under any outcome, but it is now framed as observed/spike-driven, not documented.

Scope: added TASK-016 (live turn streaming by tailing the local transcript) and TASK-017 (dead-slot buffering) rather than leaving them as risk-section concerns, because the user's resolved decisions 3 and 4 require them and PLAN_V2 contained no task that ever delivers a turn to Telegram. Alternative considered and rejected: folding both into TASK-011, which is already the largest task on the critical path.
